description: Agentic Workflow — state write validation, forbidden-scope guard, dangerous-bash deny, verification gate (Qoder). Same node scripts as the ZCode variant (hooks.zcode.json). install-qoder.js copies this file to hooks/hooks.json in the install dir, where Qoder auto-discovers it (wrapper format, per https://docs.qoder.com/zh/cli/plugins). ${QODER_PLUGIN_ROOT} is injected as env var (bash) or pre-substituted (PowerShell); timeout unit is seconds; exit 2 + stderr blocks. block-dangerous-bash backfills the executor bash deny-list that permissionMode cannot express.
